title: The Deep Salt Compression

features.name: salt pillars
features.desc-on-touch: Geometric columns of compressed mineral—the river's memory crystallized where fresh water and salt pressure met and refused to mix further. You can read stratification in the white.

features.name: pressure reading
features.desc-on-touch: A corroded gauge, face still readable: atmospheric, depth, salinity, all three needles pointing to the same angle. The archive keeps its instruments when nothing else can stay.

features.name: interface line
features.desc-on-touch: Where the water stopped moving and became stone. The boundary is still warm to touch—energy converting to form, the moment crystallized.

inscription: the pressure at which clarity becomes impossible

file.name: Salt_Column_Stratification_1987.txt
file.note: Core samples from the mouth where river surrenders to ocean. Each line a year the two couldn't agree.
